messages:
Zoe: Spotted a p99 divergence on /v1/generate around 11:03 UTC. p50/p95 fine, p99 jumped ~350ms for ~9m.
Harish: Any split by deployment/region?
Zoe: Quick slice shows green variant + EU region affected. Model_infer flat; routing and proxy_decode look noisy in sampled traces.
Gabe: Our console only shows total + model today. We should surface per-stage percentiles (ingress, routing, proxy_decode, infer, total).
Harish: Caution: computing p99 per-stage from independently sampled spans is risky. We need either consistent per-request sampling or a compact per-request map emitted at completion.
Zoe: Sketch for agent map payload: {ingress_ms,routing_ms,decode_ms,infer_ms,total_ms,sample_origin,rollout_id}. Server computes quantiles on each field.
Gabe: Fallback: if map absent, do span-join by request_id and mark the UI as "partial coverage". Add a coverage badge to the latency pane.
Harish: Also add rollout-weight overlay on the p99 timeseries so ops can spot weight shifts. Even a simple annotation for weight diffs >10% is helpful.
telemetry-bot: created task TELE-2024 to track per-request-map RFC.
Zoe: Edge case: retries. Maps should represent summed per-stage durations per logical request, not per-attempt. Add attempt_count tag for debugging.
Gabe: For the console, add a toggle "Per-stage percentiles" that requests an internal API: /internal/telemetry/stage-quantiles?endpoint=&period=. API returns rows for stages + p50/p95/p99 + coverage flag.
ops-bot: created incident INC-4987 linking this thread for triage.
Harish: Plan: RFC for agent change by EOD Wed, prototype API next week, console toggle after verifying >=85% coverage on test traffic. If coverage low, show badge and fallback to total-only view.
Zoe: Thanks. If anyone sees similar p99 spikes, drop the rollout-weight and sample-coverage screenshots into this thread. :thumbsup:
